final_draft.answer: Yes. New EBS disks in our production AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default.
final_draft.note: The approved answer on disk encryption (owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-16) gives the account as 111122223333 but doesn't call it 'production'. Another approved answer (on root MFA) names 111122223333 as the production AWS account, so that answer is cited too. A live check on 2026-11-16 at 17:09 UTC confirmed that new EBS disks in this account are encrypted by default, but it only looked at us-east-1. Encryption by default is set separately in each AWS region, and the check doesn't show the setting in any other region. If production uses other regions, please confirm the setting there before sending.
